free_tier.stated: No free inference allowance is stated. Prices are in dollars per 1M tokens at the current GNK rate and charges are in GNK; the model lineup changes through network votes.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible gateway reachable through the Gonka network, with public model, capability and status endpoints
chaining: the GNK-denominated charge and the network-voted lineup are the scarce links; no free tier is published

limits.value: charges in GNK at a dollar-per-million-token reference rate

identity_cost.detail: a gateway key is needed for inference; public model and capability endpoints need no key

reliability_note: a model the network stops serving disappears from GET /v1/models and returns 503 model_unavailable; a larger max_tokens is silently trimmed to the model cap

evidence.proved: gateway prices are shown in dollars per million tokens but charges are in GNK; the model lineup is set by network votes
evidence.quote: Prices are in dollars per 1M tokens at the current GNK rate; charges are in GNK

notes: no standing free inference allowance is published; charges are in GNK and the lineup is set by network votes
